name: Holmdel Towne Center
summary: Holmdel Towne Center is a 299,723 square foot community shopping center located on Route 35 in Holmdel, New Jersey. The property features strong anchor tenants and serves an affluent suburban market in the prime Monmouth County retail corridor.
demographics: Holmdel Towne Center serves an affluent suburban market with households averaging $150,242 in annual income within a 1-mile radius, increasing to $161,242 within 5 miles. The trade area encompasses over 523,000 residents within 10 miles, with a median household income of $118,729, indicating a strong upper-middle-class demographic. The center attracts families and professionals from the surrounding Monmouth County communities who seek convenient shopping with quality anchor tenants in a prime retail corridor along Route 35.
description: Holmdel Towne Center is a premier shopping destination strategically positioned on Route 35 in Holmdel, New Jersey, serving as a retail hub for the affluent Monmouth County area. This 299,723 square foot community center benefits from its location in one of New Jersey's most desirable suburban markets, with excellent visibility and accessibility along a major commercial corridor. The property features strong anchor tenants that draw consistent traffic from the surrounding communities, complemented by ample parking with a ratio of 5.56 spaces per 1,000 square feet. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, Holmdel Towne Center exemplifies quality retail real estate with professional management and tenant services. The center serves a prosperous trade area where households earn well above national averages, making it an attractive location for retailers seeking to reach an upscale customer base in the New York-Newark-Jersey City metropolitan area.
